svg.title: Packages of hylo-harness
svg.desc: The packages of hylo-harness by layer. Interface: cli. Evolution: evolve and learn. Evaluation: eval and catalog. Cognition: agents, memory, policies, instruments and reasoners. All build on hylo-core, the kernel: contracts, the episode kernel, the SafetyShield, traces, the plugin registry, remote protocols, the store and the conformance kit. Adapters to LeRobot, openpi, LLMs and video plug into the registry through entry points.
